Her torso angles slightly toward the viewer and the arcade interior, and her head turns toward the viewer with a natural neck turn.
rain, grey sky, night, outdoors, old town covered wooden arcade, wet stone street, warm paper lanterns, wooden railing; the arcade roofline crosses the upper third, with a receding row of shopfronts and golden ginkgo and orange maple trees beyond the eaves.
night, sidelighting, shadow; a single warm paper lantern at her left lights her from the side, so the left side of her face, scarf and jacket glow warm while the right side falls into deep shadow; only a faint cool rain fill reaches the shadow side, keeping a strong light-and-dark contrast, and the wet stone street reflects the lantern.
Eye-level three-quarter front view from slightly to her left, medium shot from thighs up; she is placed on the right third, with the wooden railing at the lower side and the arcade forms receding behind her; the roofline crosses the upper third.

blue open jacket, white sports bra, blue shorts, white sneakers. This sportswear set uses a blue open jacket with short sleeves and small spike-shaped tabs along each cuff in matte stretch fabric, blue shorts in matching stretch fabric, a plain white stretch-knit sports bra, and plain white sneakers.
smile, closed mouth; quiet contentment as she rests on the sand.
lying on her side on the beach sand, body turned sideways with her shoulders and hips in profile, her torso propped on one elbow and that forearm pressed into the sand for support, her free hand resting on her hip, her legs extended along the sand with one ankle crossed over the other, and her head turned toward the viewer with a natural neck turn.
horizon, sky, beach, ocean, sand, sunset, evening. The horizon crosses the upper third of the frame; the open sea shifts from dark blue-green near the breaking surf to warm reflected orange at the horizon, with irregular white surf lines and a shoreline that recedes behind her. Rippled dry sand and shallow tidal channels fill the near foreground, overlapping toward wet sand and a few dark rocks where the waves break, while the far water and clear evening sky hold their shapes with reduced contrast.
sunset, orange sky, evening, low sidelighting, long shadows. Low sun from the ocean side rakes across broad skin shading on the side of her turned face facing the light, the matte fabric folds of her jacket sleeve and shorts side panel, setting a clear warm lit plane against a deeper shadow on the near side of her face, waist and sand beneath her propped forearm. Weaker sky and sand bounce keep the shadow readable; contact shadows gather under the forearm and along the reclining body, while wet sand and broken surf carry broad orange reflections and the bracelets and earrings catch small hard glints.
from side, the camera is low at her body level and directly beside her reclining figure; a close full-body crop keeps her large in the frame, filling about two thirds of the frame height, with her reclining length running diagonally from the lower left toward the upper right and placed slightly right of center; her shoulders and hips read in profile while her head turns toward the viewer, and the horizon crosses the upper third behind her.
